description: Ministry of Agriculture - Amendment to the Minute of the Sri Lanka Agricultural Service, Published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 1880/26 of 19.09.2014
categorisation: This gazette notification amends the minute of the Sri Lanka Agricultural Service, specifically dealing with public service cadre management, post allocations, salary codes, and recruitment streams. It is issued by the Public Service Commission and focuses on public sector administrative matters including post classifications, promotions, and service structure adjustments, which falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
